entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the VeloBand Pulse was delivered on January 9th, which was 18 days ago.
That sounds right, yes.
Okay. And before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's just not for me. I prefer my old chest strap. So, a preference.

I understand. Unfortunately, for the VeloBand Pulse, we have a strict 10-day return policy due to hygiene protocols and how the device activates to a user's account. Since it has been 18 days, we are outside of that window.

I see. I'm aware of the policy, but here's the situation. I actually did try to return it on day nine. I went to your website, but there was a significant website error, and the whole returns portal seemed to be system down.
Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more about what happened when you tried to process the return?

Of course. I filled out the entire form, but when I hit the final 'submit' button, the page just timed out. I couldn't print the return label. I tried twice. I even took a screenshot of the error message because I figured this might happen.
Thank you for that detailed information. The screenshot is very helpful to know. Please hold for one moment while I check our internal system logs for outages around that date.

(Sound of keyboard typing) ... Okay, thank you for your patience. I've checked our records, and I can confirm that our web services team did report a known issue with the returns portal on that exact day. I sincerely apologize for the trouble that caused you.

Thank you for confirming that. So, we can process the return now? Or, look, since I've held onto it a bit longer now, how about a 30% credit and I'll just keep it and give it to a friend? That might be easier than a full return.

I appreciate the offer, but since the fault was on our end with the system down, it's only right that we honor your original intent to return. I've been authorized to make a one-time exception and can process a full refund for you today. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now.
Oh, a full refund is perfect. That's great, Charlie. Thank you for investigating that and making it right. I really appreciate it.

You are very welcome. The email should be in your inbox now. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be credited back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
